title: GEO Core Atmospheric and Geospace Sciences Program: Virtual Office Hours
summary: Oct 27 2026 2:30PM to Oct 27 2026 4:00PM EDT Program Officers from the NSF Directorate for Geosciences (NSF GEO) will discuss the GEO Core funding opportunity, focusing on one of its three programs in each session. All three sessions will start with the same information about the GEO Core opportunity, but then focus on the AGS, EAR, or OCE program with time for questions and answers. To see a previous NSF GEO office hours focusing on the entire GEO Core funding opportunity, visit the event page for the … More at https://www.nsf.gov/events/nsf-geo-atmospheric-geospace-earth-ocean-sciences-programs
